definitions.gloss: to track down, to ascertain, to pinpoint
definitions.explanation: To investigate thoroughly and determine the truth, cause, or location of something. Often used for finding the source of a problem or identifying a culprit.

examples.japanese: {原因|げんいん}を{突|つ}き{止|と}める。
{犯人|はんにん}の{居場所|いばしょ}を{突|つ}き{止|と}めた。
examples.english: I tracked down the culprit's whereabouts.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}{時間|じかん}もかけて{バグ|ばぐ}の{原因|げんいん}を{突|つ}き{止|と}めた。
examples.english: I spent hours tracking down the cause of the bug.

notes:
{突|つ}き{止|と}める means to thoroughly investigate and determine something.

CONJUGATION (ichidan verb):
- Dictionary: {突|つ}き{止|と}める
- Negative: {突|つ}き{止|と}めない
- Past: {突|つ}き{止|と}めた
- Te-form: {突|つ}き{止|と}めて

COMMON OBJECTS:
- {原因|げんいん}を{突|つ}き{止|と}める (ascertain the cause)
- {犯人|はんにん}を{突|つ}き{止|と}める (track down the culprit)
- {真相|しんそう}を{突|つ}き{止|と}める (get to the truth)
